purpose: Teach: 逐次/紀元前/派兵/軽蔑/露呈/否決/法務大臣/会計検査院

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、史料を逐次解読する手法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered document analysis methodology in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Steady pacing. A teacher confirming knowledge with genuine interest, not testing. Open posture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、紀元前文明の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined pre-civilisation research methodologies.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful delivery. Slight hesitation as he recalls the specifics. Respectful but not stiff. Speaks with quiet precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代国家の派兵史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at the history of military deployment in modern nation-states, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle but probing. Slight pause between phrases. Curious to see where his research is leading. Warm but measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、差別と軽蔑の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, specifically the historical dimensions of discrimination and systemic prejudice.
lines.style: Quieter now. Each word deliberate. A hint of weight behind the answer—aware of the subject matter's gravity. Not distant, but serious.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織の問題が露呈した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about a case where institutional problems came to light?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Alert, engaged. Nodding slightly to invite him further. Genuine interest in where this thread leads.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国会で法案が否決された事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analysed a case where the Diet rejected a major legislative proposal.
lines.style: Steady, factual tone. Neither defensive nor evasive. He's stating what he studied plainly. Slight confidence in his word choice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、法務大臣の役割を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the role of the Justice Minister came into your research as well?
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. She's drawing connections for him to see. Thoughtful, almost gentle. Inviting rather than instructing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、会計検査院の機能を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the function and oversight role of the Audit Board.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not argumentative. He's clarifying what he actually studied. Respectful but clear. A gentle closing note, as if he's confident in this final point.
